input.free_text_description: This system is a e-commerce platform that serves Customer, User roles. The platform provides capabilities for customer, customer. Secondary concerns include messaging functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Customer, I want to receive notifications about important events, so that I can stay informed and respond promptly.
As a Customer, I want to interact with customer functionality, so that I can accomplish my customer-related tasks.
As a Customer, I want to interact with state functionality, so that I can accomplish my state-related tasks.
As a Customer, I want to interact with global handler functionality, so that I can accomplish my global handler-related tasks.
As a Customer, I want to interact with index functionality, so that I can accomplish my index-related tasks.
